text:
Marta Silva: Heads-up from AeroPulse AP — their Feb renewal invoice INV-2027-0111 shows a platform add-on and full Enterprise support, but contract AMND-1310 says they downgrade to Standard on 2027-02-20. Can someone check? @JonPark @TaraSingh

Jon Park: Pasted invoice lines (PDF blocked for me):
```
Invoice INV-2027-0111
Customer: AeroPulse Aeronautics
Period: 2027-02-01 - 2027-02-28
 - Platform Fee (Private License): $20,000
 - Platform Add-on (edge-accelerator): $2,000
 - Support (Enterprise): $14,000
 - Reserved Capacity: $40,000
Total: $76,000
```

Support Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2027-0111 generated by billing-pipeline v3.4.2 — automated rule: support-tier/proration mismatch flagged for account AERO-021.

Tara Singh: Confirmed AMND-1310 shows support downgrade to Standard effective 2027-02-20. For Feb billing we should prorate Enterprise from 2/119 and Standard from 2/2028. Pipeline appears to have applied full Enterprise for the month. Also note: the edge-accelerator add-on was a one-time trial in Jan and should not bill for Feb; that's likely the $2,000 erroneous line.

Jon Park: Quick math: correct support charge = (19/28)*$14,000 + (9/28)*$9,000 = $9,500 + $2,892.86 = $12,392.86 (rounded $12,393). They were billed $14,000 => overcharge $1,607. Erroneous add-on $2,000 => total credit owed $3,607. No migration credit in this account.

Marta Silva: Procurement needs corrected invoice for AP to release PO. They asked for neutral wording and a corrected document ASAP.

Support Billing Bot: Creating ticket BILL-10088: "support prorate + expired add-on billed on INV-2027-0111". Ticket created and assigned to eng-billing.

Sales Eng: FYI sales approved we reissue invoice; want neutral language and include AMND-1310 excerpt. Also note: customer asked whether we can move payment window to 21 days to match their AP cycle. We can handle that at reissue.

Jon Park: Recommend we (1) issue credit memo CM-2027-012 for $3,607, (2) reissue INV-2027-0111R with corrected support lines and no add-on, (3) set payment terms to 21 days.

Tara Singh: Agreed. Also add a short note on the invoice: "Corrected to reflect support tier effective dates per AMND-1310 and removal of expired trial add-on." Keep wording neutral.

Support Billing Bot: BILL-10088 status: triaged. Suggested doc ids: CM-2027-012 (credit), INV-2027-0111R (reissued).

Finance Ops: Preparing credit memo and reissued invoice. Please confirm final numbers for posting.

Jon Park: Confirmed credit $3,607. Reissued invoice lines should be:
 - Platform Fee (Private License): $20,000
 - Support (prorated Enterprise/Standard): $12,393
 - Reserved Capacity: $40,000
Corrected total: $72,393. Apply CM-2027-012 ($3,607) => net due $68,786. Set payment terms 21 days.

Marta Silva: Draft neutral reply to procurement: "We identified an inconsistency on invoice INV-2027-0111 and have issued a credit memo for $3,607. A corrected invoice (INV-2027-0111R) has been posted with a 21-day payment window. We attached AMND-1310 excerpt for audit. Please let us know if you need any additional documentation."

Sales Eng: OK to send. I'll CC Sales and offer a 15-min call if they want a line-by-line.

Support Billing Bot: CM-2027-012 created for $3,607. INV-2027-0111R created and posted. BILL-10088 updated: fix in billing-pipeline will prevent billing expired add-on SKUs and correct prorate logic.

Finance Ops: Journal entries posted and revenue true-up completed. Credit applied to customer account.

Marta Silva: Customer procurement acknowledged receipt and approved PO release. Thanks team — marking resolved after AR confirms payment.

Support Billing Bot: BILL-10088 resolved after deploy. INV-2027-0111 status: corrected (INV-2027-0111R).
